operating_notes.text: AUM stood at ₹3.14 trillion as of March 31, 2026.
April 2026 New Business sum assured stood at ₹1,77,683 Cr, up 2.9% YoY.

Promoter Prudential Corporation Holdings Limited agreed to acquire a 75% stake in Bharti Life Insurance Company Limited, which is expected to require it to reduce its shareholding in ICICI Prudential Life to under 10%.
Clarified that media reports about Standard Chartered potentially exiting the bancassurance tie-up are speculative.
Retail protection APE grew 60.4% YoY in Q1FY27, the third consecutive quarter above 40% growth, and reached 10.5% of APE versus 7.5% a year earlier.
13th month persistency was 84.0% at June 30, 2026 versus 84.5% at March 2026; 25th month persistency fell from 81% to 77%.
AUM stood at ₹3.34 trillion as of June 30, 2026, with 52 bank partnerships and 1,500+ non-bank partnerships.
Assets under management stood at ₹3.29 trillion as of September 30, 2026.
H1FY27 cost/total premium excluding GST fell 30 bps to 18.3% and savings cost ratio excluding GST fell 90 bps to 11.6%.
Retail protection APE grew 47.2% YoY in H1FY27 partly aided by GST reforms, while credit life stayed flat on MFI headwinds.
95.2% of fixed income assets were in sovereign or AAA paper and 99.7% of fixed income was AA and above, with zero NPA since inception.
Company name changed to ICICI Life Insurance Limited and symbol to ICICILIFE effective October 23, 2026.

timeline.summary: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance reported FY2026 PAT of ₹1,600 Cr, up 34.6% YoY, with VNB growing 10.9% to ₹2,629 Cr.
ICICI Prudential Life Insurance clarified on April 24, 2026, that it is unaware of any developments regarding a media report on its promoter.
Promoter Prudential entered into an agreement to acquire a 75% stake in Bharti Life, which is expected to require it to reduce its shareholding in ICICI Prudential Life to under 10%.
ICICI Prudential Life clarified on May 21, 2026, that media reports regarding Standard Chartered exiting its bancassurance tie-up are speculative.
ICICI Prudential Life declared final dividend of ₹1.65 per share for FY26, subject to shareholder approval at AGM on June 30, 2026
ICICI Prudential Life received a ₹5.12 Cr GST demand order for FY2023 and announced plans to file an appeal.
ICICI Prudential Life published its FY2026 integrated annual report, reporting a consolidated PAT of ₹1,608 Cr and a solvency ratio of 227.3%.
ICICI Prudential Life reported Q1FY27 VNB of ₹571 Cr, up 24.9% YoY, with VNB margin at 26.7% and PAT up 27.8% to ₹386 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹13,803.9 Cr, net profit ₹374.22 Cr (+25.0% YoY).
October 14, 2026: ICICI Prudential Life received income tax rectification order for FY24 reducing tax demand by ₹215.6 Cr
ICICI Prudential Life Insurance announced a change of its name to ICICI Life Insurance Limited and symbol to ICICILIFE effective October 23, 2026.
ICICI Life Insurance hosted an earnings call on October 13, 2026, reporting H1FY27 VNB of ₹1,283 Cr and PAT of ₹760 Cr.
